items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Uh, he was with the Head City Band.

ctx.x: Ask him if he knew, uh...

Now, this fella, Charlie V. Lyle, he's from Baton Rouge. He was a magician of the truth. He could play any kind of instrument. He just liked, he liked, he liked, composed, anything. Uh, Walter Burke, he was a good musician of the truth. Where was he from? He had a daughter, you know. Where was he from, Walter Burke? About his age. Uh, he was with the Head City Band. That man, Charlie Vidal, you know. And, uh, he was a good piano player. I mean, a good soundball player, a musician, a water voice. And he learned…
He survived and talked to everybody.
